description: This file defines classes and types related to data elements, including DataStore, DataElement, LinkedDataElement, and DataElementParser, used for managing binary data buffers, serialization, and memory alignment within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Manages a dynamically allocated buffer for binary data, providing methods for copying data, resizing, and accessing the buffer.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data segment within a buffer, supporting read/write operations, memory alignment, copying, searching, and serialization helpers.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Extends DataElement to support linked list structures, allowing chaining of data segments with methods for traversal and copying.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Provides sequential access to a DataElement, enabling search, get, and set operations with internal offset management.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore buffer.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns or sets the size of the DataStore buffer.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates internal cache with data from another DataElement or buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the DataElement to an empty state.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the internal buffer to the specified type's alignment.

methods.name: AllocatedSize
methods.description: Returns the total allocated size of the DataElement.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement has a valid buffer.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between DataElements or DataStores.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the data segment.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the DataStore proxy associated with the DataElement.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Fills the data buffer with a specific byte value.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Expands the data buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: Shrink
methods.description: Reduces the size of the data buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another DataElement into this one.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a byte pattern within the data buffer.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number of a specific type from the buffer with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number of a specific type into the buffer with specified endianness.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves specific bits from the buffer.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets specific bits in the buffer.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Copies raw data into the buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Sets the size of the data segment, possibly reallocating.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another DataElement or LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a data segment.
